projects.title: ML-based weather forecasting
projects.excerpt: Weather predictor that ingests historical data to forecast short-term conditions with a reproducible pipeline.

details.heading: Highlights
items: Automated data cleaning, feature engineering, and train/validate splits.
Model training with cross-validation and metrics reporting.
Configurable forecasting horizons and evaluation windows.
Lightweight CLI/notebook workflows for quick iteration.
details.outcome: Actionable short-term forecasts with transparent metrics and a maintainable pipeline.

projects.title: Face comparison application
projects.excerpt: Detects and compares faces in images to estimate similarity and flag likely matches.

details.heading: Highlights
items: Drag-and-drop image ingestion with validation.
Face detection pipeline using Haar cascades.
Visual overlays communicating match confidence.
Modular architecture for alternative models.
details.outcome: Practical tool to quickly verify whether two images likely depict the same person.

projects.title: Unity Turn-Based Card Battler (Game Jam)
projects.excerpt: Turn-based card battler developed for a Game Jam, featuring strategic card mechanics, enemy combat system, and complete game loop with win/lose conditions.

details.heading: Key Features Implemented
items: Delivered feature-complete combat prototype in under 24 hours with shared documentation.
Designed a scalable Buff/Debuff system utilizing ScriptableObjects for instant content expansion.
Engineered a multipurpose infrastructure handling health, stamina (turns), and a card drafting system.
Created a robust custom debug console for testing damage calculations.
Card system with drag-and-drop card zones and enemy combat AI.
details.outcome: Fully playable turn-based card battler with polished combat mechanics and balanced gameplay.

projects.title: Unity 2D Exploration Game (Game Jam)
projects.excerpt: Atmospheric 2D exploration game focusing on custom shaders, dynamic lighting, and robust game state management.

details.heading: Technical Implementation
items: Implemented atmospheric game mechanics including dynamic lighting and resource depletion.
Wrote custom shaders with ShaderLab/HLSL to optimize the rendering pipeline for smooth visual transitions.
Architected a persistent game state manager using Dependency Injection.
Ensured data integrity across scene loads with a highly modular code structure.
details.outcome: Complete game with optimized shaders and stable architecture.

projects.title: Game Knight - Enemy AI & Combat Systems
projects.excerpt: Unity project emphasizing modular Enemy AI, custom debugging tools, and optimized physics-based movement.

details.heading: Technical Breakdown
items: Engineered a modular Enemy AI system reducing behavior iteration time by ~30%.
Developed custom debugging tools and visualizers for state machine logic.
Optimized physics-based movement and pathfinding algorithms for high performance under load.
Implemented robust spatial partitioning to manage numerous entities efficiently.
Established a strict version control workflow and simulated production environment.
Conducted code reviews ensuring clean, decoupled architecture.
details.outcome: Production-ready Unity project with robust AI systems and scalable architecture.

projects.title: CommerceHub - AI Inventory Management
projects.excerpt: AI-powered inventory backend for e-commerce using ARIMA forecasting to predict stockouts, optimize reorder timing, and generate intelligent inventory recommendations.

details.heading: Highlights
items: Engineered scalable backend API with FastAPI processing real-time e-commerce data.
Implemented strict code review standards for the ETL data pipeline.
Developed a highly accurate predictive demand model training ARIMA models.
Documented the data engineering process ensuring full reproducibility.
Delivered a fully working product handling enterprise scale in under 24 hours (team of 4).
Shopify integration API and SQLAlchemy ORM for PostgreSQL database design.
details.outcome: Built complete backend infrastructure for AI-driven inventory management system
